title: Marketplace Partnerships - Daily Notes (Samir)
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick running notes, reminders, and next steps for marketplace partners.

Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Samir
Context: Running partner onboarding for two marketplace integrations this week (VectorStore Co. + PromptTools). Light backlog of legal/ops items + engineering follow-ups.

---
Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Sync w/ Maya 10:30am - confirm vector ingestion SLA and metadata mappings (script + sample).
- [ ] Follow up with VectorStore Co. on API token rotation plan (asked legal for template).
- [ ] Confirm cost-sharing model draft w/ Liam and product (note: include 3-month trial credits).
- [ ] Send engineering readiness checklist to PromptTools PM (see checklist below).

Notes from yesterday
- Intro call with PromptTools went well. They want: low-latency hosted inference for QA, private deploy for regulated customers, and marketplace billing integration via our usage hooks.
- Engineering flagged two blockers: auth header format mismatch and missing webhook for usage events (JIRA: JIRA-MP-78).
- Legal requested a sample DPA and suggested adding our KMS options to the spec.

Partner-specific quick wins
- VectorStore Co.
  - Next: provide sample vector upload payload + mapping doc by EOD Thu.
  - Reminder: they use 512-dim embeddings; validate against our embeddings v2 output.
  - Action: set up short perf test (1000 vectors) on staging; tag test run with "vectorstore-poc".
- PromptTools
  - Next: send eng checklist; offer canary window for first 2 weeks.
  - Ask: do they need function-calling support? Confirm in PM follow-up.

Engineering checklist to send (short version)
- API auth: we support Bearer token + API key header (x-redwood-key). Confirm token format.
- Usage events: need webhook endpoint that accepts JSON payloads (POST) with fields: event_id, customer_id, tokens_used, timestamp. (Note: we use event schema v1; see CONFLUENCE-1234).
- Model pins: partners can pin model versions; include fallbacks to smaller quantized variants.
- Billing integration: enable test mode + usage hook; provide sample webhook signature verification code (Ruby/Node/Python snippets in GH PR).
- Security: require TLS1.2+, source IP allowlist option for private deploys.

Meeting action items
- Maya: get mapping doc and confirm staging perf test by 2026-03-06.
- Liam: finalize cost-sharing draft + send to finance for review by 2026-03-05.
- Eng (Ben): estimate effort to add webhook signature verification helper (due 2026-03-09).
- Legal: share DPA template; ask about KMS clauses (requested 2026-03-03).

Open questions / risks
- Will VectorStore accept our embedding dim mismatch if we apply padding/truncation? Risk: degraded recall. Proposed mitigation: run small evaluation dataset.
- PromptTools may require function-calling patterns that route traffic to a private deployment; need to confirm cost delta.
- Billing reconciliation: need clear mapping between usage events and invoice line items - connect with finance ops (Slack thread pinned).

Quick reference links
- Confluence spec: CONFLUENCE-1234
- JIRA: JIRA-MP-78
- Slack convo: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C01234567/p1670000000000

TODO (short-term)
- [ ] Draft email to VectorStore with sample payload + staging invite (Samir)
- [ ] Share eng checklist with PromptTools PM (Samir)
- [ ] Schedule 30m sync with finance to review billing mapping (Samir + Liam)

Notes to self
- Keep these notes minimal in Drive; move finalized checklists to Confluence once stable.
- Use tag "marketplace-pilot" on test runs to make it easy for dashboards.

End of scratchpad.
